# Cast — AI Character Licensing Platform

> Cast is a curated marketplace of 100% AI-generated characters, licensed for commercial use in film, video, and advertising productions.

## What Cast Does

Cast provides filmmakers, studios, and content creators with ready-to-use AI-generated characters — each with clear, enforceable license terms. No prompting required. No rights headaches.

## Who It's For

- AI filmmakers and video creators
- Studios and production companies
- Advertising agencies
- Social media content creators
- Anyone producing AI-generated video content

## Products & Pricing

Cast offers four license tiers for each character:

- **Free (Attribution)**: Use any character at no cost with visible credit to Cast. Valid 12 months.
- **Single Project License — $50 USD**: Use a character in one production. No attribution required. Valid 12 months.
- **Studio License — $250 USD**: Use a character across unlimited productions. No attribution required. Valid 12 months.
- **Exclusive Rights — $1,000 USD**: Full IP transfer. Character removed from marketplace permanently. Perpetual rights.

All licenses are worldwide and platform-agnostic (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Netflix, broadcast TV, etc.).

## Character Roster

Cast currently features 100+ curated AI characters spanning:

- Diverse ethnicities: East Asian, South Asian, Black, Latino/Hispanic, Middle Eastern, White, Southeast Asian, Mixed Heritage
- Age ranges: 20s through 60s+
- Body types: Slim, Athletic, Average, Stocky, Curvy, Plus-size
- Visual styles: Realistic, Anime, Cartoon, 3D/CGI, Stylized

Each character includes a unique name, personality description, profile image, and reference sheet for production consistency.
